== Ingredients ==
*2 tender (young) [[Cookbook:Coconut|coconuts]], flesh scooped out
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] tender (young) [[Cookbook:Coconut Water|coconut water]]
*¼ cup China grass ([[Cookbook:Agar|agar]]) strands
*2 cups [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
*½ cup [[Cookbook:Condensed Milk|condensed milk]]

== Procedure ==
# [[Cookbook:Puréeing|Purée]] the young coconut flesh in a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]], and keep aside.
# In a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], combine the tender coconut water and china-grass strands. Heat gently until the china-grass strands melt completely.
# In the meantime, heat milk and condensed milk in another saucepan over medium heat. Let it come to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]].
# To the boiled milk, add the melted china-grass mixture, and combine well.
# Remove from the flame and let it cool down for at least 5 minutes.
# Add the pureed tender coconut to the cooled milk mixture, and mix everything well.
# Pour the mixture into a [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|cake pan]] or stainless steel pan.
# Place the pudding in the freezer for about 15 minutes or until it begins to set.
# Remove the pudding from the freezer and place it in the refrigerator until fully set.
# Using a [[Cookbook:Knife|knife]], gently cut the pudding and serve it in dessert bowls.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
* You could [[Cookbook:Garnish|garnish]] the pudding with almonds, cashew nuts etc.
